messages:
Noa (Design): quick find from mobile QA: success toasts are clipping interactive edges on several console screens when compact tokens are active. users on smaller phones tap the toast instead of the intended control.
Rui - Eng: where exactly? gif would help.
Noa (Design): Models list (compact density), narrow viewport ~360px. open row menu, trigger a quick action that emits a toast; the first menu item sits under the toast. GIF attached.
Sam (Design Systems): thanks. likely two problems: compact aliases reduced visual padding without preserving hit targets, and some containers use transform which creates a stacking context so popovers fall below fixed toasts.
Claire (QA): impact: flaky taps in flows that are frequently used on phones. also focus rings get partially hidden when tabbing.
Rui - Eng: short-term patch: when a popover/dropdown opens, set the toast to `pointer-events: none` for 300ms and nudge it slightly up if there is an overlap. that preserves toast actions most of the time but avoids stealing taps during menu interactions.
Sam (Design Systems): long-term we should: 1) introduce `--touch-target-min` = 44px and ensure compact aliases never reduce effective hit area below that; 2) avoid using transform on elements that host poppers, or render poppers into a top-layer portal; 3) add a toast positioning rule to avoid overlapping any element with `data-interactive-open` attribute.
Noa (Design): also copy tweak: toasts that say just "Saved" are ambiguous when multiple things are editable. prefer contextual strings like "Connection saved" or "Filter settings saved".
Rui - Eng: noted. will prototype: protected interactive attribute + `--touch-target-min` token + responsive toast center-on-small rule. also shorten toast enter animation to 160ms to reduce overlap time.
Claire (QA): will add Percy snapshots for 320/375 widths and cover cases with open popovers, focused inputs, and swipe gestures.
release-bot: PR `edge-avoidance-hit-area-1744` opened with preview https://staging.redwood.ai/pr/3410 :white_check_mark:
Sam (Design Systems): adding a tokens linter to fail CI if any alias produces an effective hit area < 44px. follow-up: doc the `--touch-target-min` usage in tokens README.
Noa (Design): thanks team 44d3fb. merging once CI green.
